routing_result.work: The product owner names a piece of work. Agents shape it into a slice that one person can test, make its plan and write its eval. The product owner confirms each part as it is made.

unmatched_domains.name: software delivery planning
unmatched_domains.why: The field the work serves is software delivery: the product owner works on business intents, slices, plans, work items and evals before a build. None of the ten shelves (analytics, collaboration, content-management, ecommerce, experience, marketing, notifications, payments, personalization, user-management) has a trigger for that field. Collaboration's trigger is several people working on one object, which is not the job here: one product owner confirms what agents shape. The product model already holds this field as dom-software-delivery-planning.

routing_result.note: This run keeps the slice sl-intent-to-design and changes only page words, ICE lines and hidden-file entries of its features (fn-795, fn-818, fn-798, fn-898); all of them do the same job in the same field, so they are unmatched on the shelves too. In the product model they sit under cap-shape-slice, cap-718 and cap-shape-eval of dom-software-delivery-planning.
